title: Substrate-First RNA/DNA Standard
description: Defines the primary role of logic-rich JSON/PY pairs and the curated human-viewing layer.

values.name: Primary Substrate (RNA/DNA Hybrid)
values.rule: The definitive version of all logic, mission state, and legislative history MUST reside in structured '.json' and '.py' files within the 'json/' and 'py/' directories of their respective chrono-fractals.
values.rationale: JSON and Python provide the highest-fidelity, machine-readable substrate for forensic continuity and automated orchestration.

values.name: Curated Reflection (Human-Centric md/)
values.rule: The 'md/' directory is reserved for human-readable copies of important realizations, session 'Chords,' and critical mission summaries. It is a curated reflection of the underlying logic, not the primary storage location.
values.rationale: Maintains a clean, high-signal workspace for the human Rider while ensuring all data remains accessible in the machine substrate.

values.name: Abolition of .hidden/
values.rule: The '.hidden/' directory standard is DEPRECATED and removed. All artifacts previously designated as RNA reside in the primary 'json/' or 'py/' folders. High-entropy process noise or decommissioned artifacts are sequestered in 'repos/diy-make/memory/trash/'.
values.rationale: Reduces navigational entanglement and aligns with the mandate for subjective simplicity.
